sources.citation: Nikulin, Andrey. 2022. La fonologia del acento en el chiquitano migueleno. Cadernos de Etnolinguistica 10(1): e100110, 1-26; and Sans, Pierric (2010ff.) on Bésiro/Lomeriano Chiquitano prosody -- i.e. the Chiquitano literature, to be filed under chiq1248/sanm1288, not kamb1287.
sources.note: If the compilers wants a stress value for the speech of the Brazilian Kamba community, it is Chiquitano; these are the primary descriptions and are already in or targeted by the catalog under the Chiquitano keys.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (submitted by Editor, Ethnologue, SIL International). 2015. Request for Change to ISO 639-3 Language Code, Change Request Number 2015-025: retire [xba] Kamba (adopted, effective 2016-01-15). Dallas: SIL International. 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Administrative document: p.2 sec.3(c) argues Kamba [xba] is a duplicate of Chiquitano [cax] ('Since the ethnic population given for Kamba (2,000) matches that of Chiquitano [cax] in Brazil and the region given for Kamba matches the region for Chiquitano in Brazil, Kamba is most likely a duplicate of Chiquitano'), citing Loukotka 1968:118, Voegelin & Voegelin 1977:338 (both: Kamba/Camba = Tupi 'Chiriguano') and Hammarstrom 2015 citing Paula 1979 (relates Kamba to Chiquitano).
